programs.showName: Maha Ganesha The Penance Of Gajasur
programs.description: A priest tells a young boy Vignesh and his pet rat about the story of a demon named Gajasura and how Ganesha became the elephant-headed Hindu god.
Vishnu promises Goddess Parvathi that he shall rescue Shiva from the custody of Gajasura, the evil king, and soon leaves with Nandi and discovers his fascination for music and dance.
